_comment: Off-chain example shaped like EIP-8004 validationRequest payload behind requestURI. VeriTrade maps risk+intent+execution artifacts into this envelope for documentation — not an on-chain submission.
requestHashNote: On EIP-8004 chain, requestHash = keccak256(commitment to this payload). VeriTrade uses the same keccak256 helper for draft-shaped examples; intent binding remains SHA-256 over canonical intent JSON (see docs/intent-envelope.md).
